text: 1. Non-chinese citizens holding valid foreign passports and meeting the relevant requirements of the "Notice of the Ministry of Education on Regulating the Work of Accepting International Students in Our Higher Education Institutions" (Jiao Wai Han [2020] No. 12).2. Good health is required, and one must meet the physical examination standards for applying for a study visa or residence permit to China.3. High school graduation or above.4. Be friendly to China, abide by laws and regulations, have good conduct, be diligent and eager to learn, have excellent academic performance, no record of violating school rules and regulations, no public security penalties, and no criminal record.5. The score of the Chinese Proficiency Test (HSK) must reach level 5 or 6 (180 points or above). Some candidates from independent Chinese secondary schools in Malaysia are exempted from the Chinese Proficiency Test (HSK).Those who are under 18 years old by September 1, 2025, need to provide a guardian's guarantee letter.
